name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontM_cost
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (seen front : List.{0} ν),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontM N c U seen front))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontC N c U seen front)

source.code:
theorem newFrontM_cost (U : List (ν × ν)) (seen front : List ν) :
    (N.newFrontM c U seen front).cost = N.newFrontC c U seen front := by
  unfold newFrontM newFrontC
  rw [filterM_cost 1 _ (fun y => memNC c seen y + memNC c front y +
    (front.map (fun x => 1 + N.resC c U x y)).sum)]
  · congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro y _
    omega
  · intro y
    simp only [bind_cost, memNM_cost, memNM_val, pure_cost]
    rw [anyM_cost 1 _ (fun x => N.resC c U x y) (fun x => N.resM_cost c U x y)]
    omega
